assessment.planImpact: Refreshes peer evidence status and implementation crosswalk only. Keep ACadRust 0.6.3 issue reproductions, v0.6.4 release notes, mutable-main candidate fixes, and the downstream OpenCADStudio codec as distinct states. Existing local bounds, owner-closure, and auxiliary-record error-ladder subplans remain authoritative; no new local defect or duplicate test is inferred.

implementationReadyChecks: For PAR-14/PAR-26/7BE work, inspect existing generated tests first; add only uncovered count, signed-size, checked-range, bounded-allocation, no-zero-padding, or suffix-framing assertions.
Generate local mutation seeds from scratch and locate fields structurally; never copy another parser's fixed offsets or numeric caps.
For PAR-49/7G, keep null, fixed-space, valid-block, and non-null unresolved owners distinct; never invent model-space ownership to hide an unresolved source handle.
For standalone MLEADER context objects, retain the typed/raw/skip/fatal failure ladder and require ODA/sample-traced record framing before changing bounds or adding a supported route.
Do not require peer installs, peer runs, full-suite runs, or native applications per implementation slice; keep those at existing composed checkpoints.
After each implementation slice, update status, focused selector, owning CTest, and remaining prerequisite, then proceed with the next unblocked task.
Do not commit third-party DWG/DXF test fixtures unless already present in LibreCAD/libdxfrw or authored locally from scratch.

When an optional ACadRust comparison is justified, pin artifact/source/toolchain and exact input hash, report retest as NOT_RUN/NOT_RETESTED where appropriate, and do not count ACadRust plus OpenCADStudio's descended codec as independent votes.
Do not change J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, or J295 from DEFERRED_EXTERNAL based on issue reports, candidate fixes, release notes, or source visibility alone.
